correctness.rationale: Exact Dirichlet moment derivation: a two-coordinate split gives \(\mathbb E[|X_1-X_2|Q_m]=(2m+5)/(m)_3\), which with marginal means gives the stated covariance; ordered-simplex Dirichlet coordinates independently verify marginal Gini moments. The deterministic ranked quadratic identity then gives exact T mean/variance. Exponential influence functions have directly integrable covariance matrix and prove the claimed limit. Verified with 230 exact-rational checks for \(m=2,\ldots,24\); infinite proof is analytic.

value.rationale: Addresses a named published natural ranked-spacing test whose null variance requires mixed Gini–Greenwood dependence. Exact finite-m covariance calibrates its variance at every sample size, and positive correlation changes the leading variance from a naive independent-components \(49/12\) to \(37/12\). Persistent limiting correlation \(\sqrt3/2\) is structurally informative. This is not an arbitrary selected parameter or mere marginal formula.
